title: Reading Drill — Moving a Weekly Market Indoors
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Moving a Weekly Market Indoors
passages.body:
**A** During winter, a market moved into a former bus garage. Visitors entered through one doorway and left through another to reduce congestion beside the busiest stalls.

**B** The new flow worked until both queues met beside a column. Organisers marked a separate waiting area and shifted a table so visitors could still walk around people paying for food.

**C** At the end of the first month, traders held a short meeting. They suggested placing a map outside the entrance so regular customers could find their former sellers in the new building.

questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Visitors entered through one doorway and left through another to reduce congestion beside the busiest stalls.
